scorecard.rationale: The original Wang leaf-powder-in-hydrosol comparison reports shorter rat catalepsy. The Lee leaf-powder-in-water comparison has no detected difference, while some processed leaf preparations favor shorter latency. An oral ground-bark A53T experiment measures pole timing and rotarod performance. These animal outcomes differ from passive clinical rigidity. The human modified-formula trial reports composite motor results without isolating cinnamon or the rigidity item. The frozen worsening hypothesis stays open. The primary ground Cinnamomum verum MPTP comparison gives a rotarod genotype-by-treatment interaction p=.021 and inconclusive exploratory rearing and grooming interactions. The separate sodium benzoate exposure supplies no ingredient-level rigidity comparison. Motor coordination in the early-toxin paradigm cannot isolate clinical rigidity.
